info.title: EasybotCE Hub API
info.description: Implemented Hub APIs: bootstrap diagnostics, persistent endpoints/credentials, sessions, shared rule groups and directional routing. Experimental CE WebSocket 0.1.0. Full v1 is still in development; see docs/implementation-status.md. Strict JSON bodies <=16 KiB; required fields cannot be null, unknown/duplicate/case-mismatched keys are rejected. PUT replaces the complete resource. Player moderation policies and a persistent administrative audit feed are available. The plugin player-policy endpoint requires an endpoint credential with players.state. Server-scoped text command registry and capability-protected plugin execution lookup are available. Account binding challenges, unique platform/game bindings, plugin player-state publication and placeholder resolution are now implemented; see docs/accounts-and-player-state.md. OneBot action outcomes are persisted and can be listed by endpoint with cursor pagination; async acknowledgements are non-terminal.

get.description: RFC6455 upgrade; endpoint bearer required. No query string. Text session.hello within5s, identity must match credential. One live session per endpoint; capability intersection. RFC6455 Ping every20s, pong deadline10s. After welcome: message.publish only from peer; Hub sends message.deliver and message.accepted. Schema at /v1/spec/protocol.schema.json. Queue64, rate20/s burst40, dedup last1024IDs per session. Ack is not durable delivery or execution confirmation.

parameters.description: 与 before 配合使用，使用上一页响应中的 next_before_id，避免同秒创建记录被跳过。

200.description: 持久化 action 分页。items 满页时返回 next_before 与 next_before_id，用于无遗漏翻页。

adminBearer.description: Administrator token. Not an endpoint credential.

token.description: Returned only at issuance. The Hub persists SHA-256 only. Rotate by issuing a new credential, testing it, then revoking the old credential.

Rules.description: Filter include/exclude (empty means unset), ordered RE2 transforms, then single-pass template. Regex/replacement/template bounds are UTF-8 bytes at runtime. Supported placeholders: {text}, {sender_id}, {sender_name}, {source_endpoint_id}, {target_endpoint_id}. Empty template is {text}. Max output8192bytes/2048characters.

RoutingBinding.description: One directional edge. Source and target must differ. source_channel * matches all source channels. Use two bindings for bidirectional routing. Active target must advertise message.receive; source needs message.publish.

next_after.description: Pass as after; empty means end. A full last page may require one empty request.
